scope: Bounded independent primary-source critique; no new app defect established from root-reported current e345 evidence
decision: Keep current focus scrolling; explicit scrollIntoView not required by retrieved guidance; remaining layout/engine claims are hypotheses until reproduced.
attribution_corrections: APG visible-keyboard-focus short quotation belongs to example explanation, not normative WCAG text.
SC2.4.7 indicator visibility, SC2.4.11 AA minimum component visibility, SC2.4.12 AAA enhanced component visibility are distinct.
APG is informative; CSSOM source is an Editors Draft; neither provides universal browser/physical-AT acceptance.
Zero document/main movement or short-form offset change is not a cited universal requirement.
remaining_bounded_evidence: Continue already-owned EN/AR supported-engine checks with immediate focus/bounds/draft observations.
Inspect actual keyboard focus indication in existing screenshots if not already recorded.
Record document/main offsets only when investigating a concrete disruptive jump; do not demand fixed scrollTop.
Physical assistive technology remains a separate existing acceptance lane.
